id: title:Gilbert09:scope table size save to stop false url pattern rejections

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion workflow reliability and credential-guard compatibility
review.reason: The supplied hunks demonstrate a substantive, bounded improvement to warehouse ingestion reliability. P1.F1.H1 replaces an unscoped database save with a scoped update, explicitly avoiding false credential-guard rejections against stale metadata. P1.F2.H1 adds transactional isolation and a regression test for concurrent updates, preventing race-condition failures. This is not a tier
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1; no other hunks are available, so the complete implementation and broader context are not visible. The tier is assigned based on the demonstrated correctness and test coverage, not on unverified production outcomes.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are supplied; no other hunks are available, so this chunk is not complete. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaces unscoped table.save() with scoped save(update_fields=["size_in_s3_mib", "updated_at"]) to avoid false credential-guard rejection.
observations.posthog_connection: This warehouse ingestion activity updates only size_in_s3_mib; an unscoped save could trigger credential-guard checks against stale url_pattern, potentially rejecting a valid size update. Scoped save avoids that false mismatch.

observations.behavior: Adds transaction=True and a test that simulates a concurrent url_pattern update while the activity computes size, asserting the size update still succeeds and the url_pattern change is preserved.
observations.posthog_connection: This warehouse ingestion workflow can take time; a concurrent change to url_pattern could otherwise cause the activity to reject its own update. The test demonstrates the fix allows the size update while preserving the concurrent change.
